ticket.title: Early Resale: profit, reversal, loss cut (1 s delay)
ticket.description: Hypothesis: resale rules matter more than settlement. Same follow-flow entry as the reference; exits: profit target +12%, momentum reversal (bid falls 3 cents from a peak that was >= 2 cents above entry), loss reduction (after 30 s, cut a position down >= 3%), hard stop -8%, 90 s max hold. Paper only; $100 bankroll, $5 max per opportunity; 1 s delay, depth-limited fills, realistic fees.

LIVE-BTC15M-FollowFlow-1.label: LIVE-DATA PAPER TEST
LIVE-BTC15M-FollowFlow-1.caveat: Paper trades on a recorded 3-minute live market tape (2026-11-22, ~15:30-15:33 ET) with degraded source latency. This is NOT validated trading performance, and its fills were not realistically executable: it assumed the tape's displayed ask, with data that arrived late.
warnings: Source latency: venue-to-receipt delay was p50 11.0 s, p95 27.6 s, max 33.5 s (observer lag measured 2026-11-22; 0.1 s p50 on 11/19). Quotes seen by the ticket were up to ~30 s old.
Feed gaps: 3 reconnects; the book had drifted from the venue snapshot across 2 of them before the reader resynced. Quotes between a disconnect and the resync may be stale.
Frozen at master v1.1.0, which has no quote-staleness guard. Ticket is stopped; its one open position is NOT settled and is valued at the last observed bid.
Tiny sample: 3 signals, 3 buys, 2 closed trades (both losses). No conclusion about the strategy can be drawn.
